Messages.Author: DJ Monet
Messages.Body:
The zip gun says it functions as a weapon- does this mean I can use
ammo cards with a zip gun? I assume it's also treated as an equipment
card...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Current card text (most recent printing):

Before range is determined, put this card on this minion. This card
represents an equipment card and doesn't count as a combat card while
in play. This equipment is a Weapon: Gun. Ammo cards cannot be used
with this gun. It does 1R damage each strike, with an optional maneuver
each combat. Bearer takes 1 damage during strike resolution when this
gun is used, but only once each combat. This card is kept as normal
equipment and not discarded after combat.

--

still considered "gun is used"? Basically, is the zip gun a good way
for a free manuver each combat?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
DJ Monet wrote:
> If I decide to use the optional manuver, but not fire the [zip] gun, is that

> still considered "gun is used"? Basically, is the zip gun a good way
> for a free manuver each combat?

Moot. If you use the maneuver, that means you strike with the gun.
[6.4.3]

Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:
<snip>

>
> If I decide to use the optional manuver, but not fire the gun, is that
> still considered "gun is used"? Basically, is the zip gun a good way
> for a free manuver each combat?
>

As per section 6.4.2 in the rulebook it states:

If a minion uses the maneuver from a strike card or a weapon, he is
effectively choosing his strike as well.

So if you use the maneuver from the zip gun, you have already chosen to
strike with the zip gun.

Archibald Zimonyi
